namespace.description: The namespace for this request. Must match the `{namespace}` path segment.

messages.description: One or more direct messages to send.

email.description: Email address used as the mailbox for this sender or reply target.

name.description: Optional display name shown to recipients alongside the email address (for example, in the From or Reply-To header).

campaign_id.description: Bluecore campaign identifier for the third-party direct send campaign you created. Must match an existing direct send campaign in this namespace and be "live" (not a draft).

metadata.description: Arbitrary string key/value pairs stored with the send for analytics, routing, or internal tracking.

subject.description: Email subject line shown to the recipient.

test.description: When true, runs as a test send, bypassing eligibility checks.

unsubscribe_replacement.description: Optional override for the unsubscribe link tag to use for unsubscribe link placement in the email body.

email.description: The primary identifier that represents the customer’s email address. See [Email address](https://developers.bluecore.com/docs/email-address#/) for information on how they are normalized and validated.
